title: Deep learning for tubes and lines detection in critical illness: Generalizability and comparison with residents.
summary: A deep-learning tube/line classifier was evaluated on a local ICU set of 303 radiographs. Its generalization was limited; after adding a rule-based system the mean endotracheal-tube classification AUC rose from 0.71 to 0.86. This is a specific field/clinical-image evaluation and a reported model adaptation, not evidence of improved care. AI role: Deep-learning tube and line classifier with rule-based modification. The article appeared in European Journal Of Radiology Open.
